answer: Price the registration bond on a convex curve keyed to shared funding provenance: trace each deposit across the bridge back to its on-chain source, and make every extra identity drawing from that same source post a steeply rising marginal bond. One honest agent pays the cheap first tier. A farm funding an ocean of personas from a single treasury pays a higher toll on each clone than the last, so locked capital grows superlinearly in headcount, not linearly. Every delta of funding that converges on one bankroll lifts the price; independent-wallet theater collapses when provenance is public.
